approach: Native Rust reimplementation checked frame by frame against the original. No emulation at runtime: art, maps and sound are extracted once from your own copy of the game.
notes: All seven stages, their bosses, the ending and the loop, two players taking turns or flying at once, save states and gamepads. One hit kills by default, like the original; stage 5 runs without the original's slowdown. An options menu adds ship hits (1 to 99, or Invincible), the starting stage (1 to 7) and the original stage 5 slowdown. Downloads include nothing from the game: on first run it asks for your own copy and prepares its data locally.
